batch_node.name: AWS Core collector schedule v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Seeds a Schedule that fires the AWS Core (boto3) collector once per day at 12:00 UTC. Paired with the Samsite Compliance schedule (midnight) so AWS resource state is refreshed mid-day and compliance synthesis runs ~12 hours later against the fresh data. The SCHEDULED_TARGET edge points at the AWS Core collector entity, whose entity_id is the UUIDv5 derived from its registry scope:key per req-tap-cares-collector-model-10.

node.name: AWS Core collector — mid-day
node.description: Runs the AWS Core (boto3) collector once per day at 12:00 UTC to refresh the AWS resource graph (Route53 / CloudFront / S3 / Lambda / IAM / ...) for the registered AWS account(s).

entity.name: AWS Core mid-day schedule SCHEDULED_TARGET aws_core collector
